introduction: The sandbox agent, agentkit-sandboxd, confines its own process with a Linux Landlock ruleset before any other work. Every tool call and every process a tool starts can then write only beneath the workspace and the agent's private directories, can read only the system directories, and under NetworkNone can neither bind nor connect TCP. The agent reports exactly what it applied through Hello and AgentInfo, Spec.RequireLandlock turns a missing or partial ruleset into a Create failure, and no host-side code path ever confines the process that embeds AgentKit.

glossary.ABI: The Landlock ABI version a kernel offers (1 = Linux 5.13 filesystem, 2 = 5.19 refer, 3 = 6.2 truncate, 4 = 6.7 TCP bind and connect). Kernel ABI is what the probe returned; applied ABI is the version of the ruleset actually applied, capped at 4.
glossary.BestEffort: go-landlock's Config method that silently downgrades to whatever the kernel supports, including to nothing; this module never calls it.
glossary.Landlock: The Linux security module that lets an unprivileged process restrict its own filesystem and network access irreversibly. Child processes inherit the restriction across fork and exec.
glossary.LandlockInfo: The host-side value in package sandbox that mirrors the agent's LandlockReport: ABI, KernelABI, TCP, Note, Writable and ReadOnly.
glossary.Plan: The pure function Plan(kernelABI, probeErr, mode) in sandbox/internal/confine that chooses the applied ABI, the TCP flag and the note.
glossary.confine package: sandbox/internal/confine, the only package that imports go-landlock and the only place a ruleset is built and applied; imported only by sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd.
glossary.effective spec: The Spec after CheckSpec has applied its defaults, as attach.New and sandbox.AgentArgs see it.
glossary.fakeagent: 13's in-repository test agent whose Hello response is configurable.
glossary.probe: The single call that asks the kernel for its Landlock ABI (landlock_create_ruleset with LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION). Tests replace it through an unexported seam.
glossary.re-executed child: A test that runs its own test binary as a child process, so that a regression that confines a process confines only the child.
glossary.ruleset: The set of Landlock rules the agent applies to itself: writable roots, read-and-execute system directories, read-only /proc, read-write device files and, under NetworkNone at ABI 4, TCP handling with no port granted.
glossary.system directories: /usr, /bin, /sbin, /lib, /lib32, /lib64, /libx32, /etc and /opt, which the ruleset makes readable and executable.
glossary.temporary directory: TMPDIR of the agent's explicit environment, else TEMP, else TMP, else /tmp: the parent of 13's default spill directory <temporary directory>/agentkit-spill.
glossary.writable root: A directory under which the ruleset grants every filesystem right of the applied ABI: the workspace, HOME, the temporary directory and each --landlock-rw path.

requirements.title: The ruleset
requirements.rationale: The ruleset grants exactly the access tools need, and nothing else, so that execute and its children cannot write outside the workspace and the agent's private directories.

criteria.action: grant every filesystem access right the applied ABI defines, including execute, refer at ABI 2 and later and truncate at ABI 3 and later, beneath each writable root: the workspace given by --workdir, HOME from the agent's environment, the temporary directory resolved exactly as 13's agent resolves its default spill location, and each --landlock-rw path
criteria.contract: a process under the ruleset can create, rename across directories, truncate and execute files beneath every writable root

criteria.action: grant read and execute beneath /usr, /bin, /sbin, /lib, /lib32, /lib64, /libx32, /etc, /opt and each --landlock-ro path, read only beneath /proc, read and write on the device files /dev/null, /dev/zero, /dev/full, /dev/random and /dev/urandom, and no other filesystem access
criteria.contract: a process under the ruleset that creates a file outside every writable root, or reads a file outside every listed root, fails with EACCES

criteria.condition: the agent runs with --network none and the applied ABI is 4
criteria.action: handle TCP bind and TCP connect in the ruleset and grant no port, so that every TCP bind and connect from the agent and its children is denied, loopback included
criteria.contract: the report's TCP is true; a TCP connect to a listener on 127.0.0.1 fails

criteria.condition: the agent runs with --network allowlist or --network unrestricted
criteria.action: handle no network access right in the ruleset, leaving TCP to the provider
criteria.contract: the report's TCP is false; a TCP connect to a listener on 127.0.0.1 succeeds

criteria.condition: a system directory, a device file, or a --landlock-ro or --landlock-rw path does not exist
criteria.action: skip that path and apply the rest of the ruleset, silently for a system or device path and with a note naming the path for a flag path
criteria.contract: the path is absent from Writable and ReadOnly, the apply succeeds, and Note names every skipped --landlock-ro or --landlock-rw path

criteria.condition: HOME or the temporary directory is unset, relative, missing, equal to `/`, or equal to or an ancestor of a system directory
criteria.action: skip that root and apply the rest of the ruleset
criteria.contract: the root is absent from Writable, the agent starts and serves, and Note names the skipped variable and the reason it was skipped

criteria.condition: --workdir or a --landlock-rw path is `/` or equal to or an ancestor of a system directory, or a --landlock-ro or --landlock-rw path is relative
criteria.action: refuse to start, applying no ruleset and serving nothing
criteria.contract: exit status 2 and one line on stderr naming the offending flag

criteria.action: for any set of roots, resolve each root with filepath.EvalSymlinks before adding its rule, collapse roots that resolve to the same path into one rule, and list the resolved paths in the report's Writable and ReadOnly in the order their rules were added, with the device files under Writable and /proc under ReadOnly
criteria.contract: Writable and ReadOnly contain no duplicate and no unresolved symlink path

requirements.title: Choosing and applying the ABI
requirements.rationale: An explicit, reported choice of ABI replaces BestEffort's silent downgrade, keeps the floor at ABI 2 so git keeps working, and makes a refused apply fatal instead of serving unconfined.

criteria.action: for any kernel ABI from 0 to 8, a probe error, and each of the network modes none, allowlist and unrestricted, make Plan(kernelABI, probeErr, mode) return: after a probe error, ABI 0, TCP false and the note `Landlock unavailable: <error>`; for kernel ABI 0, ABI 0, TCP false and `kernel reports no Landlock support`; for kernel ABI 1, ABI 0, TCP false and `kernel Landlock ABI 1 cannot permit cross-directory renames (needs ABI 2, Linux 5.19); not applied`; for kernel ABI 2 or 3, the kernel's ABI, TCP false and, under none, `kernel Landlock ABI k cannot restrict TCP (needs ABI 4, Linux 6.7)`; for kernel ABI 4 or later, ABI 4, TCP true only under none, and an empty note under none and unrestricted

criteria.condition: the network mode is allowlist and Plan's applied ABI is above 0
criteria.action: make Plan's note state that Landlock cannot express a host allowlist and that TCP is left to the provider
criteria.contract: TCP is false and the note contains both statements

criteria.action: keep Plan a pure function in a file with no build constraint, so that it compiles and is tested on every platform, and probe the kernel's Landlock ABI exactly once per process through a probe function that tests replace via an unexported seam to simulate kernel ABI 1 to 3 and probe errors

criteria.condition: Plan returns an applied ABI above 0
criteria.action: apply a go-landlock configuration of exactly that version (V2, V3 or V4) carrying the ruleset of 15-REQ-1, through Restrict when TCP is true and RestrictPaths otherwise, setting no_new_privs on all threads as part of applying, and never calling BestEffort
criteria.contract: after the call returns nil, every thread of the agent and every process it starts is confined and PR_GET_NO_NEW_PRIVS returns 1

criteria.condition: the probe fails, for example with ENOSYS, EOPNOTSUPP or a seccomp EPERM
criteria.action: continue without applying a ruleset
criteria.contract: the agent serves, and its report has ABI 0, KernelABI 0, TCP false and the note `Landlock unavailable: <error>`

criteria.condition: building or applying the ruleset fails after a successful probe
criteria.action: exit without serving any RPC
criteria.contract: exactly one line `agentkit-sandboxd: landlock: <cause>` on stderr and exit status 1

criteria.condition: the agent is built for a GOOS other than linux
criteria.action: apply nothing, through a !linux stub that imports no go-landlock package
criteria.contract: the report has ABI 0, KernelABI 0, TCP false and the note `Landlock is Linux-only (GOOS=<os>)`

criteria.action: report the ABI the probe returned as KernelABI, unchanged by the cap at 4, and 0 after a probe error
criteria.contract: kernel ABI 6 under none gives ABI 4, KernelABI 6 and TCP true

requirements.title: The command, its flags and its start-up order
requirements.rationale: The agent cannot infer the network mode, a missing flag must narrow the boundary rather than widen it, and confinement must precede every other piece of work.

criteria.action: accept, besides 13's --workdir, --ttl and --version, exactly the flags --network none|allowlist|unrestricted (default none), --landlock-ro PATH and --landlock-rw PATH, the last two repeatable, and no flag that disables or weakens confinement
criteria.contract: parseFlags with no --network yields mode none; each repeated --landlock-ro or --landlock-rw value is kept in command-line order

criteria.condition: --network has a value other than none, allowlist or unrestricted
criteria.action: refuse to start without applying a ruleset or serving
criteria.contract: exit status 2 and one line on stderr naming --network

criteria.condition: agentkit-sandboxd is run with --version
criteria.action: print the agent version and `(protocol 1.2)` without probing or applying Landlock and without serving
criteria.contract: stdout contains `(protocol 1.2)`; exit status 0

criteria.action: in main, parse the flags, then handle --version, then compute and apply the ruleset, and only then redirect stdout, call agent.New, start any goroutine of its own and serve
criteria.contract: an AST test over the command's source fails, naming the file and line, if a call to redirectStdout or agent.New, or a go statement, precedes the confinement call in main

criteria.action: pass the outcome of confinement to the agent as data through the new field agent.Config.Landlock of type sandbox.LandlockInfo, applying the ruleset to the agent's own process so that every process a tool starts inherits it
for any effective spec, make sandbox.AgentArgs(spec Spec) []string return `--ttl <spec.TTL>`, `--network <spec.Network.Mode>` and, only when spec.Workdir is non-empty, `--workdir <spec.Workdir>`
criteria.contract: parsing AgentArgs(spec) with the command's parseFlags yields the spec's TTL and network mode, and its Workdir when set, else the command's default workdir

requirements.title: Reporting the applied ruleset
requirements.rationale: The embedder can only enforce what it can see, so the agent reports field by field what it applied and the host never guesses.

criteria.action: add `LandlockReport landlock = 7` to HelloResponse, with message LandlockReport { uint32 abi = 1; uint32 kernel_abi = 2; bool tcp = 3; string note = 4; repeated string writable = 5; repeated string read_only = 6; }, and regenerate the checked-in sandboxpb code and its hash file with `make proto`
criteria.contract: `make proto` on a clean tree leaves no diff

criteria.action: set ProtocolMinor to 2 and leave ProtocolMajor unchanged
criteria.contract: TS-14-5 and every test that pinned minor 1 pin 2; TS-13-24 expects `1.2`

criteria.action: export type LandlockInfo struct { ABI int; KernelABI int; TCP bool; Note string; Writable []string; ReadOnly []string }, the constants LandlockMinABI = 2 and LandlockTCPABI = 4, and the field AgentInfo.Landlock of type LandlockInfo
for any LandlockInfo l and NetworkMode m, make l.Satisfies(m) true exactly when l.ABI >= LandlockMinABI and, when m is NetworkNone, l.TCP is also true
criteria.contract: returns a bool

criteria.condition: the agent answers Hello
criteria.action: return agent.Config.Landlock as HelloResponse.landlock field for field, and have attach fill AgentInfo.Landlock from that report field for field
criteria.contract: Sandbox.Agent().Landlock equals the LandlockInfo the command passed to agent.New

criteria.condition: the agent's Hello reports ProtocolMinor 1 or lower and carries no LandlockReport
criteria.action: fill AgentInfo.Landlock with ABI 0 and the note `agent protocol 1.N does not report Landlock`, N being the agent's minor version
criteria.contract: for a 1.1 agent, Agent().Landlock.ABI is 0 and Note is `agent protocol 1.1 does not report Landlock`

criteria.condition: the local provider runs the agent in the embedder's process
criteria.action: apply no ruleset and pass agent.Config.Landlock with ABI 0 and the note `in-process agent (local provider): no confinement`
criteria.contract: Sandbox.Agent().Landlock.ABI is 0 and Note is `in-process agent (local provider): no confinement`

requirements.title: The agent under its own ruleset
requirements.rationale: The ruleset is only worth applying if the agent and its tools keep working inside it, and its effect must be observable end to end on a real kernel.

criteria.condition: the agent's ruleset is applied
criteria.action: serve Hello, Tools, Call, SyncTar, ExportTar and 14's Rsync over the stdio descriptors it already holds, writing only beneath the workspace and the temporary directory
criteria.contract: a tar sync, a LocalDir sync and an export against the confined agent each return a nil error and the expected files

criteria.condition: the applied ABI is above 0 and a Tools request carries an explicit SpillDir that is not beneath a writable directory root
criteria.action: refuse the request and build no tool set
criteria.contract: gRPC InvalidArgument whose message names the SpillDir and the writable roots; the sandbox stays live

criteria.condition: the applied ABI is above 0 and a Tools request carries no explicit SpillDir
criteria.action: accept the request with the default spill directory, which always passes the writable-root check
criteria.contract: Tools returns the tool definitions

criteria.condition: the agent runs on Linux with kernel Landlock ABI 4 or later, --network none, workspace W, HOME=H and TMPDIR=T
criteria.action: let a proxy execute call create files under W, H and T, and deny it creating a file in a sibling directory outside all three, reading with cat a file outside the ruleset, and connecting to a TCP listener on 127.0.0.1
criteria.contract: the three creations succeed; the sibling creation and the cat fail with a permission error; the connect fails; Agent().Landlock has ABI 4, TCP true, and the resolved W, H and T among Writable

criteria.condition: the agent runs on Linux with kernel Landlock ABI 4 or later and --network unrestricted
criteria.action: let a proxy execute call connect to a TCP listener on 127.0.0.1
criteria.contract: the connect succeeds and Agent().Landlock.TCP is false

criteria.condition: the agent runs on Linux with kernel Landlock ABI 2 or 3
criteria.action: apply the filesystem ruleset at the kernel's ABI, so that the filesystem outcomes of 15-REQ-5.4 hold, and leave TCP unrestricted
criteria.contract: Agent().Landlock.ABI equals the kernel's ABI, TCP is false, and Note names the missing TCP support under none

criteria.condition: the agent's ruleset is applied
criteria.action: leave the tools' environment unchanged and let binaries under the system directories run
criteria.contract: `env` in a proxy execute prints exactly the agent's explicit environment; `/bin/sh -c true` and `go version` exit 0

requirements.title: Spec.RequireLandlock
requirements.rationale: An embedder that depends on the second boundary can make its absence a Create failure, checked statically before allocation and dynamically after Hello, always as a SpecError.

criteria.action: add Spec.RequireLandlock bool, false by default, and Capabilities.Landlock bool, true when the provider starts agentkit-sandboxd in a way that lets it apply its ruleset; the local provider reports Capabilities.Landlock false

criteria.condition: a spec that passes every check 13 defines has RequireLandlock true and caps.Landlock is false
criteria.action: refuse the spec before anything is allocated
criteria.contract: a *SpecError with Field "RequireLandlock" for which errors.Is(err, ErrUnsupported) is true

criteria.action: for any Capabilities and Spec, agree with TS-13-13's oracle extended by the RequireLandlock rule: refuse with Field "RequireLandlock" exactly when 13's checks pass, RequireLandlock is true and caps.Landlock is false, and report the earlier field whenever one of 13's checks fails

criteria.condition: the local provider's Create receives a spec with RequireLandlock true
criteria.action: refuse it without creating a sandbox directory
criteria.contract: Create returns a nil Sandbox and an error naming RequireLandlock that matches ErrUnsupported; no new directory exists afterwards

criteria.condition: after Hello, the effective spec has RequireLandlock and AgentInfo.Landlock.Satisfies(spec.Network.Mode) is false
criteria.action: close the client and run the provider's destroy step exactly once
criteria.contract: attach.New returns a nil Sandbox and a *SpecError{Provider, Field: "RequireLandlock", Reason} matching ErrUnsupported, whose Reason quotes the agent's ABI, its kernel ABI, the TCP flag and the note

criteria.condition: after Hello, the effective spec has RequireLandlock and AgentInfo.Landlock.Satisfies(spec.Network.Mode) is true
criteria.action: accept the sandbox
criteria.contract: attach.New returns a live Sandbox and nil, for example for ABI 3 under NetworkUnrestricted and for ABI 4 with TCP true under NetworkNone

criteria.condition: the effective spec has RequireLandlock and the agent speaks protocol 1.1 or lower
criteria.action: refuse the sandbox as 15-REQ-6.5 describes
criteria.contract: a nil Sandbox and a *SpecError matching ErrUnsupported whose message contains the agent's protocol version; the destroy step runs exactly once

criteria.action: add attach.Config.Provider string and copy it into SpecError.Provider of every RequireLandlock refusal

requirements.title: The host is never confined
requirements.rationale: Landlock is irreversible and inherited, so a single import rule and a re-executed child keep any regression from confining the embedder.

criteria.action: import github.com/landlock-lsm/go-landlock or any of its subpackages only from non-test files under sandbox/internal/confine, each constrained by //go:build linux, as an AST test in internal/policy over every non-test Go file enforces
criteria.contract: the test fails, naming the file, for any such import elsewhere or in a confine file without the linux constraint

criteria.action: import sandbox/internal/confine only from sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd, so that sandbox/internal/agent, attach, local and sandbox never reach it
criteria.contract: the AST test fails, naming the importing file, for any other importer

criteria.action: contain no call to a method named BestEffort in any non-test Go file
criteria.contract: the AST test fails, naming the file and line, for any such call

criteria.condition: a process creates a local sandbox, syncs a tar into it, gets its tools, runs a proxy execute and closes it
criteria.action: leave that process unconfined
criteria.contract: afterwards the process creates a file in a fresh directory outside the workspace and connects to a TCP listener it opened on loopback, both without error

requirements.title: Dependency, gates and public surfaces
requirements.rationale: Exactly one existing module is promoted without moving any version and the existing build, size and API gates stay green; if the selected version lacks an assumed symbol, psx's cgo variant needs a new environment variable, or a version would move, the case is recorded in docs/errata/sandbox_landlock_agent.md and the work stops.

criteria.action: require github.com/landlock-lsm/go-landlock directly at the version already selected after 14 (PRD 11 names v0.10.1), so that the direct set gains exactly that module, change no module version, and keep kernel.org/pub/linux/libs/security/libcap/psx indirect
criteria.contract: `go list -m all` output equals the committed snapshot unchanged; TS-14-42 and TS-13-65's direct-set literal expect go-landlock as direct and pass

criteria.action: list github.com/landlock-lsm/go-landlock in approvedDeps with a one-line reason comment
criteria.contract: TS-09-15 and TS-09-16 pass

criteria.action: pass the cross-target gate (build and vet for linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 with cgo off) and the host-cgo gate without adding any environment variable to either, and stay within TS-12-14's budget of 20,000 non-test Go lines without raising it
criteria.contract: `make check` exits 0

criteria.system: agentkit, core, tools and codemode packages
criteria.action: leave every exported identifier and exported signature of these four packages unchanged, the doc comment of tools.Workspace being the only exported declaration whose text changes

execution_paths.title: A confined agent denies writes outside its roots and all TCP under NetworkNone

steps.action: on Linux with kernel Landlock ABI 4 or later, builds sandbox/cmd/agentkit-sandboxd and starts it with --network none --workdir W and the environment HOME=H, TMPDIR=T, holding pipes to its stdin and stdout
parses its flags, probes the kernel ABI once, and Plan chooses ABI 4 with TCP
resolves W, H, T, the system directories, /proc and the device files, and applies a V4 configuration through Restrict with no port granted
redirects stdout, calls agent.New with Config.Landlock set to the outcome, and serves over stdio
attaches over the child's pipes, calls Hello and fills AgentInfo.Landlock from the LandlockReport
runs proxy execute calls that create files under W, H and T, create a file in a sibling directory, cat a file outside the ruleset, and connect to a listener the test opened on 127.0.0.1

finds the three creations succeeded, the sibling creation and the cat failed with a permission error, the connect failed, and Agent().Landlock has ABI 4, TCP true and W, H and T among Writable, then closes the connection and the agent exits 0

execution_paths.title: RequireLandlock refuses an agent that reports too little and destroys it

steps.action: calls attach.New over fakeagent, whose Hello reports protocol 1.2 and a LandlockReport with ABI 3 and TCP false, with an effective spec carrying RequireLandlock and NetworkNone, Provider "fake" and a counting destroy step
runs Hello, fills AgentInfo.Landlock from the report, and finds Satisfies(NetworkNone) false
closes the client and runs the destroy step once

receives a nil Sandbox and a *SpecError with Provider "fake" and Field "RequireLandlock" matching ErrUnsupported whose reason quotes ABI 3, the kernel ABI, TCP false and the note, and finds the destroy count is 1

execution_paths.title: A re-executed child runs the local provider, which stays unconfined and says so

steps.action: re-executes its own test binary as a child with an environment marker that selects the child role
calls local.Unisolated().Create with RequireLandlock and receives a *SpecError naming RequireLandlock that matches ErrUnsupported, with no sandbox directory created
creates a local sandbox without RequireLandlock and reads Agent().Landlock with ABI 0 and the note `in-process agent (local provider): no confinement`
syncs a tar, gets the tools, runs a proxy execute and closes the sandbox
creates a file in a fresh directory outside the workspace and connects to a TCP listener it opened on loopback, then exits 0 when both succeed or non-zero naming the failed check
asserts that the child exited with status 0

execution_paths.title: An embedder requires Landlock, starts the confined agent with AgentArgs, syncs a project, runs a tool and exports the result

steps.action: on Linux with kernel Landlock ABI 4 or later, checks a spec with RequireLandlock, NetworkNone and Workdir W against Capabilities with Landlock true, and starts the built agentkit-sandboxd with sandbox.AgentArgs(effective spec) over pipes
applies its ruleset before agent.New, then serves the Agent service over stdio
runs Hello, reads protocol 1.2 and a LandlockReport with ABI 4 and TCP true, finds Satisfies(NetworkNone) true, and returns a live Sandbox
calls Sync with a LocalDir of a host project, which runs 14's Rsync stream against the confined agent
runs a proxy execute that uses /bin/sh to write out/result.txt into the workspace
calls Export into a host LocalDir, finds out/result.txt with the written content, closes the sandbox, and the agent exits 0

symbols.name: Config
symbols.signature: type Config; values V2, V3, V4
symbols.notes: Module source is outside the repository; signatures are those PRD 15 assumes.

symbols.name: Config.Restrict
symbols.notes: Restricts filesystem and network; with no network rule every TCP bind and connect is denied. Assumed to set no_new_privs and reach every thread through psx.

symbols.name: Config.BestEffort
symbols.notes: Never called; an AST test forbids it.

symbols.name: LandlockGetABIVersion
symbols.notes: If absent, the fallback is syscall.Syscall(444, 0, 0, 1), landlock_create_ruleset(NULL, 0, LANDLOCK_CREATE_RULESET_VERSION); 444 on amd64 and arm64.

symbols.name: syscall.Syscall
symbols.signature: func Syscall(trap, a1, a2, a3 uintptr) (r1, r2 uintptr, err syscall.Errno)
